audit.whatIsWrong: The page's tracked ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is a fabricated name — Hwei's CC palette is Subject: Torment (E), 12s cooldown, holding Grim Visage (fear), Gaze of the Abyss (root) and Crushing Maw (pull). audit.why: Packet defect list confirms none of Hwei's real ability names appeared; enemy kit gives E 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 and W 18-16 with a shield flag.
audit.corrected: Every prose mention of Subject: Fear replaced with Subject: Torment (E); cooldowns rewritten with 12s/18s and the shield-force-out rule; bleeds replaced.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.

Hwei out-scales into a four-item zone controller: Spiraling Despair plus his full palette carves teamfights you cannot enter from the front. Flank with R, force his 18-second W shield before diving, and close the game before his third item — your combo stops one-shotting around then.
